result.workResult: The Program control-plane start state was missing and was persisted exactly once through scheduler fallback, then fetched and verified before review. Main was reviewed for all five long-term programs. TMPA has current S0.6 RC and I0.7 publication evidence; FCoP has current boundary/evidence work and pinned v3.2.5 references; CodeFlowMu has the I0.7 locked evidence and WP-13 field case; Digital Employee has the maintained Digital Employee Works positioning and prior release evidence; Research Operating System has the active V5 Scheduler and Worker Contract. However, the declared Program Runtime input does not exist as operational data: no independent Program queue artifacts for the five programs are present on main. Search results for Program queues resolve only to the Runtime contracts and the general Research Queue, which is not a substitute for the independent Program queues required by V5. Therefore no Program Queue -> Research -> Review -> Program Publication lifecycle transition can be authorized without inventing state. Zero transitions and zero Program publications were performed.
result.workResult_zh: Program 控制面的启动状态缺失，已通过 Scheduler fallback 恰好补写一次，并在评审前重新 fetch 与核验。随后分别检查五个长期研究计划在 main 上的当前证据：TMPA 已有 S0.6 RC 与 I0.7 正式发布证据；FCoP 已有最新边界/证据工作并固定 v3.2.5 引用；CodeFlowMu 已有 I0.7 锁定证据与 WP-13 现场案例；Digital Employee 已有持续维护的 Digital Employee Works 定位与既有发布证据；Research Operating System 已有正在生效的 V5 Scheduler 与 Worker Contract。但 Program Runtime 声明的输入目前并不存在为可操作数据：main 上没有这五个研究计划各自独立的 Program Queue 产物。对 Program Queue 的检索只命中 Runtime 合同和通用 Research Queue，而后者不能替代 V5 要求的独立 Program Queue。若继续推进就必须臆造生命周期状态，因此本次不授权任何 Program Queue -> Research -> Review -> Program Publication 转换，执行 0 个转换、0 个 Program 发布。
